subject: design/implement-now-issue-entry
statement: Dispatch the admitted task through the existing implementation path in `cmd/implement-now/run.go`, `internal/executor/dispatch`, and `internal/executor/worker`. Reuse backend resolution, native requirements routing, lease, deterministic branch, disposable workspace, fresh harness invocation, local gate, bounded repair, duplicate-proposal association, code-host adapters, checks, and durable review handoff.
